```{r}
#| results: asis
source("scripts/shared.R")

# One square tile per organization, linking to its page. The Logos column
# of lobbyist_list.csv lists member-logo files (";"-separated) from
# files/images/lobbyist_logos/ — one logo fills the plate, several compose
# a small cluster (how conglomerate lobbies are shown). No logos = a
# monogram in the org's color. Spending power (when set) is a corner badge.
lobbys <- read.csv(LOBBY_CSV) |> mutate(Code = toupper(Code))

tiles <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(lobbys)), function(i) {
  l <- lobbys[i, ]
  color <- if (!is.na(l$Color) && l$Color != "") l$Color else "#17345a"

  logo_files <- character(0)
  if ("Logos" %in% names(l) && !is.na(l$Logos) && l$Logos != "") {
    logo_files <- trimws(strsplit(l$Logos, ";")[[1]])
    logo_files <- logo_files[file.exists(file.path("files/images/lobbyist_logos", logo_files))]
  }

  face <- if (length(logo_files) > 0) {
    imgs <- sprintf('<img src="files/images/lobbyist_logos/%s" alt="">', logo_files)
    sprintf('<span class="tile-plate%s">%s</span>',
            if (length(logo_files) > 1) " multi" else "",
            paste(imgs, collapse = ""))
  } else {
    sprintf('<span class="tile-mono">%s</span>', l$Code)
  }

  badge <- if (!is.na(l$Spending.Power) && l$Spending.Power != "") {
    sprintf('<span class="tile-badge">%s</span>', l$Spending.Power)
  } else ""

  sprintf('<a class="tile" style="--tile-color:%s" href="%s/%s.html">%s%s<span class="tile-name">%s</span></a>',
          color, LOBBY_PAGES_DIR, l$Code, badge, face, l$Lobby)
}, character(1))

cat('<div class="tile-grid">', paste(tiles, collapse = "\n"), '</div>')
```
